status: structure win, latency neutral; the regression is attributed to requirement-scaffold object interning, not node visits

latency_release_fresh_process_ms.finding: halving the interpreted node visits changed nothing outside noise, so node-visit count is not the cost driver

corrected_cost_attribution.method: compare every kernel work counter between the pre-change candidate, the post-change candidate and the K0 baseline on TodoMVC fresh-process diagnostics

intern_requests_by_kind.finding: the extra interning is dominated by kind 1 objects (nonempty objects: +976k requests) and kind 2 (+367k)

corrected_cost_attribution.conclusion: the requirement machinery builds and interns roughly a million scaffold objects per TodoMVC diagnostics solve, one per reverse-projection step per call, plus four times K0's scratch-pool churn.
